info.title: uploadimg public API
info.description: DOCUMENTED PROPOSAL ONLY; not implemented/deployed. Anonymous image sharing; separate from existing local /api/images. See uploadimg-v1.md for lifecycle and security gates.

servers.description: Relative contract surface only; no production origin selected. Native client uses explicitly configured HTTPS API and web origins.

post.summary: Publish a consented image or reconcile an idempotent replay
post.description: Bounded admission/provisional processing claim may precede receiving body. Processing same-key requests may return 409 without body comparison. Compute final fingerprint from actual bounded bytes+MIME before final comparison/commit. 48-hour ledger starts at first reservation; after purge historical key recognition is not guaranteed. Client POST retries require user action, same retained immutable bytes/key, and at most 10 minutes. Ready replays recheck availability. Desktop durably saves receipt capability and minimal accepted-operation metadata before first POST, without image bytes; persistence failure prevents transfer. Optional receiptState failed proves durable terminal failure only for422 invalid_image,507 storage_full,503 storage_unavailable,500 internal_error. 400/411/413/415/429 are never stored terminal. No same-key POST after marked failure. Unknown outcomes query GET; only GET404 upload_unknown with original retained bytes and <10min permits explicit UserRetry, never automatic POST. Invalid input, not_found and upload_expired do not allow identical old-key retry.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 256-bit random lowerhex64 anonymous secret receipt capability; never log or place in a URL. Invalid/missing POST key: 400. Invalid/missing result key: 404.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: Exact encoded request bytes; absence 411, malformed/mismatch 400, above cap 413. A stream must remain bounded regardless of declared value.

requestBody.description: Raw binary only; static image, 10,000,000 encoded bytes, 16,000,000 decoded pixels, 8,192 pixels per edge. Declared/decoded MIME must match. No filename or source metadata.

201.description: Newly ready image, durable publication complete and accessible. Not a queued response.

Content-Location.description: Required relative optimized image resource; ID must match response id.

200.description: Matching ready replay, currently accessible. Same immutable result; never extends expiry.

400.description: Malformed request, invalid key, or invalid/mismatched length.

404.description: Previously ready image is blocked or deleted before expiry; do not replay an old ready result.

409.description: Different fully computed fingerprint: idempotency_conflict. Still processing: upload_in_progress, potentially before body read, with Retry-After required for that code only.

Retry-After.description: Required only for upload_in_progress; not required for idempotency_conflict.

410.description: Successful image expired while its 48-hour receipt record remains; never resurrect it.

413.description: Encoded body exceeds cap; reject without unbounded read.

422.description: receiptState failed means durable terminal commit; without marker this does not prove a stored terminal failure. An unmarked server/lookup failure leaves outcome unknown.

429.description: Rate limit or bounded admission capacity reached; no unbounded queue.

Retry-After.description: Required positive integer seconds. Honor within bounded client window.

unmarked.summary: Unknown outcome or lookup/admission error; consult receipt, not terminal proof.

recorded.summary: Durably recorded terminal failure; never rePOST this key.

get.summary: Recover the outcome without transferring image bytes
get.description: Secret header capability; rate-limited. Invalid/unknown/purged receipt404. Expired ready410 while retained; blocked/deleted ready404. Revalidate availability, never replay stale success. Recorded terminal errors use their original documented status/code. Timeout/500 may still be unknown; do not automatically resend POST. GET422/507 requires receiptState failed; GET500/503 may be unmarked lookup error (Unknown) or marked terminal failure. GET202 remains Unknown. GET404 upload_unknown permits explicit same-key UserRetry only with original retained bytes and <10min; restart/no bytes requires reselection, consent and new key. not_found/410 and terminal marker forbid old-key retry.

post.summary: Accept a bounded reason-only report for an accessible image
post.description: Maximum raw JSON body1024 bytes. Repeated reports MUST preserve first accepted reason. Acceptance does not automatically block image, change expiry or promise completed moderation. Operator response/retention is a public-release gate.

requestBody.description: application/json reason enum only; at most1024 bytes, bounded while reading.

ReceiptCapability.name: Idempotency-Key
ReceiptCapability.description: Anonymous secret receipt capability, not person/app authentication. Random256-bit lowerhex64. POST and result only; no developer secret bundled in app.

ReadyImage.description: Clients ignore unknown additive fields, validate required fields, exact id/url agreement, and expiresAt-readyAt=86400000. Limits are decimal bytes/pixels.

url.description: Relative path only. Resolve against configured web origin and validate path/id/origin before Copy/Open.

error.description: Stable machine code; unknown codes fail safely.

message.description: Human text; no stack, path, image, clipboard or other-upload details.

receiptState.description: Optional only on upload POST or receipt GET, only after durable terminal-failure commit. Absent marker never proves persistence. Framing/admission and read/report errors must omit it.

example.message: The image could not be accepted.

RecordedUploadFailure.description: Durably committed terminal receipt only. Exhaustive HTTP/code pairs:422 invalid_image,507 storage_full,503 storage_unavailable,500 internal_error. Never rePOST this key; new share requires reselection, consent and new key.
